question: Which paper in the literature collection introduces an ultra-thin CdS electron-transport layer, and how many devices in the experimental database contain CdS in their ETL stack?
final_answer: The paper introducing an ultra-thin CdS electron-transport layer has the DOI 10.1246/cl.180616 (titled "Ultra-thin Cadmium Sulfide Electron-transporting Layer for Planar Perovskite Solar Cell"). In the experimental database, there are 58 devices that contain CdS in their ETL stack sequence.
